what: Round 1218. Which competitions a modern Club Manager save can play use a video assistant referee in 2026-27. kickOff asks this file (through the generated src/data/clubManagerVarRates.ts): a match gets reviews only when its competition's row says yes for that stage.
rules: yes and no need two independent publishers that speak of the 2026-27 season. Fewer than two is unknown.
unknown plays WITHOUT reviews. Thin data is marked, never filled. A row turns on with data alone: add the second source, run node scripts/genCmVarRates.mjs, nothing else changes.

Keys are the engine's own: league:<league id of REAL_LEAGUES>, cup:<cup name of LEAGUE_RULES>, ucl. A cup or the Champions League row carries from, the first stage with reviews (cup: R16, QF, SF, F; ucl: group, R16, QF, SF, F).
A source that only repeats another's text (one agency story on two sites) counts once.

In the closing fix of 2026-10-10 a search was run for Serie B, the Segunda, the Saudi Pro League and the FA Cup and nothing was filed (one page each or none that names the competition in 2026-27; the FA Cup pages found speak of 2025-26).
